display.purpose: Page titles only. Fixed 1.5rem, not fluid.

label.purpose: Uppercase field names and table headers.

mono.purpose: Ticket ids, counts, and keyboard hints.

shadows.name: drawer
shadows.purpose: Right-edge sheets such as the ticket drawer.

shadows.name: popover
shadows.purpose: Menus, dialogs, and toasts. Token name is --shadow-pop.

motion.name: ease-out-desk
motion.purpose: Hover and color state on buttons, cards, and fields.

motion.name: ease-out-drawer
motion.purpose: Drawer entrance. No bounce, no elastic.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single filled action: new ticket, save, confirm.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; height: 30px; padding: 0 11px; border-radius: 4px; border: 1px solid var(--sig, oklch(0.455 0.135 262)); background: var(--sig, oklch(0.455 0.135 262)); color: var(--sig-ink, oklch(0.988 0.003 85)); font: 500 0.8125rem/1 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.011em; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--sig-hi, oklch(0.395 0.145 262)); border-color: var(--sig-hi, oklch(0.395 0.145 262)); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--sig, oklch(0.455 0.135 262)); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Default Button
components.description: Secondary actions on the desk: cancel, filter, toolbar.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 30px; padding: 0 11px; border-radius: 4px; border: 1px solid var(--rule, oklch(0.892 0.006 85)); background: var(--panel, oklch(0.963 0.004 85)); color: var(--ink, oklch(0.245 0.014 262)); font: 500 0.8125rem/1 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn:hover { background: var(--panel-2, oklch(0.938 0.005 85)); border-color: var(--ink-3, oklch(0.515 0.012 262)); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--sig, oklch(0.455 0.135 262)); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Toolbar and form fields. 16px type below the touch breakpoint.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; font: 600 0.6875rem/1.25 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.055em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--ink-3, oklch(0.515 0.012 262)); } .ds-input { height: 30px; padding: 0 9px; border: 1px solid var(--rule, oklch(0.892 0.006 85)); border-radius: 4px; background: var(--panel, oklch(0.963 0.004 85)); color: var(--ink, oklch(0.245 0.014 262)); font: 400 0.8125rem/1 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.011em; text-transform: none; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--sig, oklch(0.455 0.135 262)); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--sig-wash, oklch(0.455 0.135 262 / 0.09)); }

components.name: Chip
components.description: Priority and state stamps on cards and rows.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 18px; padding: 0 6px; margin-right: 4px; border-radius: 3px; border: 1px solid var(--rule, oklch(0.892 0.006 85)); background: var(--panel, oklch(0.963 0.004 85)); color: var(--ink-2, oklch(0.480 0.011 262)); font: 600 0.6875rem/1 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-chip-late { color: var(--warn-hi, oklch(0.46 0.14 62)); border-color: var(--warn-line, oklch(0.58 0.13 68 / 0.42)); background: var(--warn-wash, oklch(0.58 0.13 68 / 0.12)); }

components.name: Ticket Card
components.description: Board card. Flat paper, hairline, mono id in Signal Blue.
components.css: .ds-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; gap: 6px; width: 220px; text-align: left; padding: 10px 11px 9px; border: 1px solid var(--rule, oklch(0.892 0.006 85)); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--paper, oklch(0.988 0.003 85)); color: var(--ink, oklch(0.245 0.014 262)); cursor: pointer; } .ds-card:hover { background: var(--panel, oklch(0.963 0.004 85)); border-color: var(--ink-3, oklch(0.515 0.012 262)); } .ds-card:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--sig, oklch(0.455 0.135 262)); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-card-id { font: 600 0.75rem/1 ui-monospace, monospace; color: var(--sig, oklch(0.455 0.135 262)); letter-spacing: -0.02em; } .ds-card-title { font: 500 0.8125rem/1.35 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.name: Pipeline Rail
components.description: Signature stage geometry. Current segment is Signal Blue. Lanes are gaps, not colors.
components.css: .ds-rail { display: flex; gap: 1px; width: 220px; height: 8px; } .ds-rail i { display: block; flex: 1; border-radius: 1px; background: var(--rule, oklch(0.892 0.006 85)); } .ds-rail .is-done { background: var(--sig-line, oklch(0.455 0.135 262 / 0.35)); } .ds-rail .is-now { background: var(--sig, oklch(0.455 0.135 262)); }

components.name: Top Search
components.description: Top bar search. Shrinks with the bar; height follows the control token.
components.css: .ds-search { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; height: 30px; max-width: 280px; padding: 0 9px; border: 1px solid var(--rule, oklch(0.892 0.006 85)); border-radius: 4px; background: var(--panel, oklch(0.963 0.004 85)); color: var(--ink-3, oklch(0.515 0.012 262)); font: 400 0.8125rem/1 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-search:hover { border-color: var(--ink-3, oklch(0.515 0.012 262)); } .ds-search:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--sig, oklch(0.455 0.135 262)); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-search kbd { font: 400 0.625rem/1 ui-monospace, monospace; border: 1px solid var(--rule, oklch(0.892 0.006 85)); border-radius: 3px; padding: 1px 4px; background: var(--paper, oklch(0.988 0.003 85)); }

narrative.overview:
This is the interface of a delivery desk, not a campaign page. A lead scans ticket stage, ownership, and access on a laptop in ordinary daylight. The same desk stays usable after hours, so dark mode is the night shift of the same tokens, not a second product. Density is high because the work is a list, a board, and a drawer. Personality comes from the pipeline rail and from mono ticket ids, not from decoration.

The system rejects the generic tool look: big metric heroes, identical icon cards, gradient headlines, glass panels, and a second accent "to add energy." Light paper is the ground. Signal blue is scarce. Rules are hairlines. Shadows appear only when a surface lifts off the desk (drawer, popover, toast).
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper surfaces, ink text, one blue signal
Pipeline rail as the signature: filled segments, gaps between lanes, no extra hues
System sans at 13.5px; mono only for ids, counts, and keys
Flat at rest; `--shadow-pop` and `--shadow-drawer` only when a layer actually floats
Touch density starts at 820px: control height becomes 44px, inputs become 16px

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Signal blue marks the current stage, the primary button, links, and the keyboard focus ring. It is not a background for sections, not a sidebar wash, and not a gradient.

rules.name: The Paper Ground Rule
rules.body: Light is the default scene. Dark mode is the same ledger after hours: every color is a redefinition of an existing token. A hardcoded hex that ignores data-theme is a defect.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Headings, buttons, labels, and body share the system sans. Mono is for identifiers and numbers. A display serif or a second sans is prohibited in the product UI.

rules.name: The Flat Desk Rule
rules.body: Resting surfaces have no drop shadow. If a shadow shows on a card, a list row, or a form section, it is wrong. Motion that lifts a control (translate, scale, elastic) is also wrong; state changes use color and border in 120 to 180ms ease-out.

dos: Do theme through the tokens in frontend/app/design-system.css (--paper, --ink, --sig, --alarm, --warn, --ok, and their washes). Dark mode only redefines those variables.
Do keep Signal Blue on the current stage, the primary button, links, and the focus ring.
Do use the pipeline rail (filled segments, 1px gaps) when showing stage. Do not replace it with a row of colored dots.
Do use --ctl-h for side-by-side controls, 44px at the 820px breakpoint, and 16px input text there so mobile Safari does not zoom.
Do use --shadow-pop or --shadow-drawer when a layer floats. Resting cards stay flat.
Do give data tables a stacked or wrapping layout under 820px. The ticket list already does this. People, notification settings, analytics, and RBAC tables must follow.
donts: Don't add a second brand accent, a purple gradient, or a neon dark theme. Night is the same ledger.
Don't use border-left or border-right thicker than 1px as a colored status stripe on toasts, QA items, list rows, or callouts.
Don't use gradient text (background-clip: text) for titles, metrics, or loading labels.
Don't use glass blur, hero metric blocks, or identical icon-card grids.
Don't introduce another button shape beside .btn. The shadcn Button must match .btn (30px, 4px radius, Signal Blue) or it should not ship on product screens.
Don't hardcode hex, #000, or #fff in components. UI QA status chips that use #fff4e5 / #e8f1ff / #e8f7ee break dark mode.
Don't reference var(--shadow). That token does not exist.
Don't use bounce or elastic easing. The assistant fab's cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1) is the counterexample.
Don't put Ink Quiet on Panel Shade, or Amber (--warn) on Warm Paper as text. Both fail 4.5:1.
